name: Sabi
notes: AI executive assistant for small-business founders, run primarily over SMS and iMessage with Slack, email and a web app: inbox, calendar, tasks, KPIs and social, with Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Stripe, QuickBooks, HubSpot, Asana and Notion integrations. From HLDFST Inc, co-founded by Stephen Diaz and Bruce Van Zyl. Pricing sits behind a login; a free starter plan and time-limited founder pricing are mentioned. Requested via the form by a co-founder (issue #339).
tagline: An AI chief of staff for founders who run their company by text
